task: Colorize the point cloud /home/user/Documents/plain.ply (350 ASCII points, no color) by assigning an RGB color value to every point. Export the colored cloud as a binary little-endian PLY at /home/user/Documents/plain_colored.ply with RGB color columns included. The output must still contain all 350 points and carry RGB color.
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/plain.ply in CloudCompare. It is an ASCII PLY with 350 points and no color. Use Edit > Colors (for example 'Set unique...', 'Colorize', or 'Height Ramp') to give every point an RGB color. Then export the now-colored cloud as a binary little-endian PLY at /home/user/Documents/plain_colored.ply with the RGB color columns included in the export. The output must still contain all 350 points and carry RGB color.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: 1) Create scalar field from coordinates (cloud sf-from-coord), 2) Convert to RGB (cloud sf-to-rgb), 3) Export with RGB (export cloud --preset ply)
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI supports colorization through scalar field manipulation: create SF from coordinates, convert SF to RGB colors, then export with color preservation.
